ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw report was ingested into the dashboard by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source catalogue CSV file from which this record was extracted

reportFolder.description: Folder or path of the source catalogue CSV file from which this record was extracted

product_id.description: Product identifier from the DHUS archive catalogue (CSV Id)

product_name.description: Product file name from the DHUS archive catalogue (CSV Name)

content_length.description: Product file size in bytes (CSV ContentLength)

ingestion_date.description: Date the product was ingested into the DHUS archive (CSV IngestionDate)
